name: Extraordinary Materials
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces.  Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
narrative.objectives: Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.

giverName: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IX
startItemText: an item: Logistics Task Briefing IX
